chapter: Youth, the road and arrival in California
title: Henry's Furnace nightclub in Cleveland
summary: He worked at the club in the Majestic Hotel around 1935 until his father took him home.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: I mentioned the Majestic Hotel. Well, there was a nightclub in the hotel called Henry's Furnace, and I... I know I'm mixing my times up here, because this was the second time when I'd come back to Cleveland, that I got hired to work in this place.
Do you know what year this was?
I think that must have been about 1935, because my father came and got me and made me...took me back home. That was before I got out here.
